note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number exist for USA (Minneapolis, Chicago) and Germany (Frankfurt), latest 2026-02-28. Note the declared HS 870899 is not the code seen in the records — actual observed export HS codes are 87089100 (radiators/parts), 84195099 (heat exchangers) and 86079100 (locomotive parts); per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: the search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck.com, trademo.com, eximpedia.app and volza.com all returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown and domestic_evidence = null — this is a data-access gap, not a finding of no domestic supply. Revenue/export volume figures: null, not public in the free views read. Address seen in the customs record: "1/12 INDL.ESTATE GORWA" (Gorwa industrial estate, Vadodara, Gujarat) — this conflicts with the claimed state Tamil Nadu and should be checked against the MCA registered address.
